site_content.title: Engineering quality into every stage of delivery
site_content.title_en: Engineering quality into every stage of delivery
site_content.title_zh: 将工程质量融入交付的每个阶段
site_content.summary: A closer look at the quality system behind complex industrial projects.
site_content.summary_en: A closer look at the quality system behind complex industrial projects.
site_content.summary_zh: 了解复杂工业项目背后的质量管理体系。
site_content.content_en:
Quality throughout delivery

Complex industrial equipment brings design, manufacturing and on-site work together. Clear requirements and traceable records connect quality management across these stages.

From requirements to inspection

  • Review operating conditions during engineering.
  • Record material, fabrication and inspection information.
  • Bring commissioning findings into the handover documentation.

Reliable delivery starts with attention to detail at every stage.
site_content.content_zh:
贯穿交付全过程的质量管理

复杂工业装备的交付涉及设计、制造和现场工作。明确的技术要求与可追溯的记录，将各阶段的质量管理连接起来。

从需求评审到检验交付

  • 在工程设计阶段评审运行工况。
  • 记录材料、制造过程和检验信息。
  • 将调试结果纳入最终交付资料。

可靠交付，始于每个阶段对细节的关注。

site_content.title: Supporting efficient operations at a major port
site_content.title_en: Supporting efficient operations at a major port
site_content.title_zh: 助力大型港口高效运营
site_content.summary: Our team completed equipment integration and commissioning.
site_content.summary_en: Our team completed equipment integration and commissioning.
site_content.summary_zh: 我们的团队完成了设备集成与调试。
site_content.content_en:
Equipment integration at the port

Our team completed equipment integration and commissioning to support efficient port operations. The work connects mechanical equipment, control systems and the operating environment.

Commissioning and handover

The project team reviews equipment interfaces and operating procedures during commissioning. Clear handover information supports the people who operate and maintain the equipment.
site_content.content_zh:
港口设备集成

我们的团队完成了设备集成与调试，助力港口高效运营。相关工作将机械设备、控制系统与实际运行环境连接起来。

调试与交付

调试阶段，项目团队共同检查设备接口与操作流程。清晰的交付资料为后续设备操作和维护提供支持。

site_content.title: Building long term partnerships through engineering
site_content.title_en: Building long term partnerships through engineering
site_content.title_zh: 以工程实力建立长期合作伙伴关系
site_content.summary: Collaboration and lifecycle support across international markets.
site_content.summary_en: Collaboration and lifecycle support across international markets.
site_content.summary_zh: 跨国际市场的协作与全生命周期支持。
site_content.content_en:
Engineering through collaboration

Industrial projects depend on understanding requirements across teams, disciplines and markets. Long term partnerships support practical communication throughout a project.

Support across the equipment lifecycle

Collaboration continues beyond delivery. Sharing operating feedback and maintenance needs helps engineering teams understand how equipment is used in the field.
site_content.content_zh:
在协作中推进工程项目

工业项目需要不同团队、专业和市场之间对需求形成共同理解。长期合作为项目全过程中的务实沟通创造条件。

设备全生命周期支持

协作在交付后持续进行。运行反馈和维护需求的共享，帮助工程团队了解设备在实际现场中的使用情况。

site_content.title: Inside our heavy equipment manufacturing capability
site_content.title_en: Inside our heavy equipment manufacturing capability
site_content.title_zh: 走进我们的重型装备制造能力
site_content.summary: A view of the people and processes behind reliable delivery.
site_content.summary_en: A view of the people and processes behind reliable delivery.
site_content.summary_zh: 了解可靠交付背后的人员与流程。
site_content.content_en:
People and processes behind manufacturing

Heavy equipment manufacturing combines engineering drawings, fabrication planning and the work of skilled teams. Coordinating these activities turns a design into equipment ready for delivery.

A connected manufacturing process

Material preparation, fabrication, assembly and inspection each contribute to the final result. Communication between these stages helps teams address practical manufacturing questions.
site_content.content_zh:
制造背后的人员与流程

重型装备制造将工程图纸、制造计划与专业团队的工作结合起来。各项工作的协调推进，使设计逐步转化为可交付的设备。

相互衔接的制造过程

材料准备、制作、装配和检验共同影响最终结果。各阶段之间的沟通，帮助团队及时处理制造过程中的实际问题。
